title: 103 E Kingston - Vacation Rental in Rosemary Beach,FL | 30a Escapes
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… "103 E Kingston," your luxurious retreat in Rosemary Beach Community. Featuring a private heated pool, a detached carriage house, and outdoor loggia with a fireplace and grill, this beautifully designed spacious 5 King suite home for up to 12 guests offers everything you need for a sophisticated 30A vacation. Located near world-class restaurants, shopping, and just steps from the heated Sky Pool. Learn more below…*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Private Heated Pool with Waterfall Feature, seasonally heated for year-round enjoymentSpacious Layout with 4 King Suites in the main houseDetached Carriage House with 1 King Suite, plus an additional loft for 2 extra guestsStunning Loggia with Fireplace and Gas Grill, perfect for alfresco diningChef’s Kitchen with High-End Appliances for gourmet cookingSteps to the Heated Sky Pool and St. Augustine GreenIncludes 7 Bikes for exploring the 30A areaDriveway Parking for 3 Cars – a Rosemary rarity!Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐"This home is perfect for large groups! We loved the covered patio, private pool, and the spacious downstairs gathering area. Would definitely stay again!" – Carrie J.⭐"Perfect house for our family vacation! The carriage house was a great bonus. We loved how close it was to the beach and town!" – Dina D.⭐"Great for 5 adult couples—each with their own king bed and en suite! Would stay again." – Leigh Ann M.*** LIVING AREAS ***Step into relaxation as you explore the open concept living space, centered around an elegant fireplace accented by French doors leading to the outdoor loggia. This home features two spacious living rooms—perfect for movie nights or unwinding after a day by the pool.Main Living Room with Accent Fireplace and Pool AccessUpstairs Lounge with Wine Cooler and Flat Screen TV*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Cook like a pro in the chef’s kitchen, equipped with top-of-the-line appliances and high-end finishes. Serve meals at the custom farmhouse dining table or enjoy a casual bite at the breakfast bar.Chef’s Kitchen with High-End Appliances and Ample Counter SpaceDining Table for 8 and Breakfast Bar Seating for 4Fully Stocked with Cookware, Dishware, and Utensils*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Unwind outdoors with your private heated pool and waterfall feature, spacious loggia complete with a gas grill, and a cozy fireplace for cooler evenings.Heated Pool with Waterfall FeatureLoggia with Outdoor Fireplace, Gas Grill, and Seating for 67 Bikes Included for Guest Use*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor:​Primary Suite: Luxurious King Bed, Pool Access, Spa-Like En-suite Bath with Dual Vanity, Freestanding Tub, and Oversized Walk-In Shower2nd Floor:Primary Suite 2: King Bed, 180° Window Walls, Private En-suite BathroomBedroom 3: King Bed with Private En-suite Bath and Shared Balcony AccessBedroom 4: King Bed with En-suite Bathroom and Pool-View BalconyCarriage House:King Bedroom with Full Bath and Loft with 2 Twin Beds*** ROSEMARY BEACH COMMUNITY ***Immerse yourself in the charm and luxury of the Rosemary Beach community, a stunning beachside destination known for its award-winning architecture and idyllic ambiance. Whether you're seeking adventure, relaxation, or romance, this vibrant locale offers something for everyone.Rosemary Beach Community: Beachside destination with award-winning architectureRacquet Club – one of the world’s top 75 tennis spotsMultiple parks & greens with playgrounds, a splash pad, butterfly park, and hidden boardwalks with fountainsFitness Center with massage and yoga4 RESORT POOLSBarbados Pool: Gulf-side, French West Indies style with a fountainCoquina Pool: Gulf-side, with a relaxing negative edge overflowSky Pool: Park-side, indoor, heated year-round with radiant heated decking in winterCabana Pool: Park-side, cabana-style with a children’s pool & playground nearby*** LOCATION ***2-Min Walk to Sky Pool and St. Augustine Green5-Min Walk to On-Site Boutique Shops and RestaurantsShort Stroll to Emerald Waters and Sugar-White Sands*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independently.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to get access to the 7 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesLSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.Private pool can only be heated between the dates of September 1st - April 30th.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 5034STRO #: STR-005034

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
